steps.description: The goal is to open the OKX Web3 homepage and then interact with elements on that page. Currently we are on about:blank with no interactive elements, so the first necessary step is to navigate to the target URL. Once the page loads, we can proceed with clicking the required elements.

The user wants to click the left-top '行情' link after loading the OKX Web3 homepage. In the current screen, the element with ID hexa-2 is an anchor with text '行情', which matches the required target. We'll click it and wait for the next page to load before proceeding to the next steps.
The user wants to click the '热议' button after opening the market page. The current screen shows a div with text '热议' and ID hexa-18, which matches the required element. So we should click it.
The user wants to click the '连接钱包' button after having clicked '行情' and '热议'. In the current screen the '连接钱包' element is identified as hexa-13. So the next step is to click that element.

The user has completed navigation, clicked '行情', '热议', and '连接钱包'. The next step is to close the wallet popup. The popup close button is represented by the element with ID hexa-267 (<i aria-label="关闭">). Clicking this will close the modal, completing the goal.
